title: What to do if you can't find your original ball after hitting a wrong ball
question: You have played a wrong ball and cannot find your original ball. What should you do according to the rules?

choices.text: Drop a ball within one club-length of where you last played your correct ball and add one penalty stroke
Drop a ball anywhere on the course and add two penalty strokes
Go back to the tee and start again with no penalty
Continue playing with any ball you find

explanation: If the correct ball cannot be found after playing a wrong ball, you must return to where your last proper shot was made, drop a ball within one club-length of that spot, and add one penalty stroke (for a lost ball).
